last_result.headline: Q36 smoke PASSED and the full 760-well run is in flight (ETA ~3.7 h). Two corrections to Q19 established: it patched the WRONG PF (standalone single-seed, not the deployed likelihood-weighted ensemble -- so its tail failure was measured where no averaging damping could occur), and it scored the PF standalone when base = 0.5*dwt + 0.5*pf exactly, halving any effect. Smoke confirms the patch activates and alignment holds 12/12; provisional hint is that the tail-driven signature persists inside the blend (helps 16.7% of wells). NS=32 vs deployed NS=64 understates damping, conservatively.
